evidence.excerpt: We introduce a psychometric benchmark for computational replicas: personas that carry a fixed identity through an evolving sequence of events.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 36 open-weight and proprietary LLMs from nine developers (1B-671B parameters), most recover the direction of established relations (84.3% mean agreement) and the variance partition (26 of 34), yet the within-person correlation and distributional structure elude recovery.
